title.text: What if yours was the last light?

lines.l_only: Every light on Earth is out. Except yours.
lines.l_neighbours: Your neighbours walk toward the only light.
lines.l_street: Then the whole street follows you.
lines.l_city: By midnight, the whole city has found you.
lines.l_stars: Above you, 2,500 stars appear. Nobody looks.
lines.l_space: From space, Earth is dark. Except one dot.
lines.l_battery: But your battery has other plans.
lines.l_dark: A third of us never see the Milky Way.
lines.l_push: Everyone pushes toward the last light.
lines.l_lookup: And for the first time, everyone looks up.

endcard.title: Would you share the last light?
